author: Peter Hellberg
description: The classic 2048 puzzle: slide the numbered tiles, merge matching pairs and keep doubling them until you build the 2048 tile.

descriptions.en: The classic 2048 puzzle: slide the numbered tiles, merge matching pairs and keep doubling them until you build the 2048 tile.
descriptions.it: Il classico puzzle 2048: fai scorrere le tessere numerate, unisci quelle uguali e continua a raddoppiarle fino a ottenere 2048.
